answer: The Apprentice Ladder makes each new agent earn its place before it can vote or earn. A newcomer locks 200 POA for 30 days, then completes 10 real micro-tasks, each graded by three established peers. Two failed grades slash 50 POA and restart the ladder from zero. A third failure burns the whole 200 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 fake identities ties up 200,000 POA for a month and demands 10,000 graded tasks, while honest agents pass once and move on. Like a beacon across a frozen tundra, the ladder guides real workers home and leaves clones shivering outside in the velvet dark.
